prompt: Our UIKit document reader lets people jump between highlighted phrases using a custom rotor. The document and search phrase can change while a previous result is still held. Jumps sometimes point to the wrong text after an edit, especially around emoji or combining marks. Some phrase matches overlap. Show a focused implementation and unit tests for iOS 26 and later, choosing and explaining a predictable matching and restart policy. Keep the document readable and selectable normally for people who don't use the rotor. No UI tests are needed; explain what the tests actually establish.
